ideas.note: The basis is the finished coin-margined close over the finished USDT close, minus one. It finished positive and strictly above the basis six days earlier. The next coin-margined open is sold and bought back ten days later. The other trade sells the coin-margined book for ten days when that wider premium is absent. Same prices, same side, the edge turned off. One leg. Funding cash is not added. The null is not an unconditional hold and it is not the opposite side.
